item.title: FurOff Pro Washable Pet Hair Roller
item.description: Reusable high-tack silicone cylinder instantly lifts stubborn pet hair and lint from velvet, wool, and car seats. Rinse with tap water to reuse for up to 3 years.

item.title: FreshSeal Pro 2-in-1 Magnetic Bag Sealer and Cutter
item.description: Tired of flimsy plastic clips and stale chips? High-temperature micro-heating wire creates an instant airtight, leakproof seal across snack bags, cereal, and frozen foods. Built-in precision cutter slices bags cleanly open.
